TS0210001.solution: Correct the request body, then send it again.

TS0210002.message: Authentication failed: invalid username or password.
TS0210002.solution: Check the username and password are correct, then sign in again.

TS0210003.solution: Sign in with `login` to obtain a session token, or present a machine token with `--token`.

TS0210004.solution: Sign in as a user with that capability, or use a token issued with that scope.

TS0210005.solution: Check the Server URL and availability, then retry the tool call.

TS0210006.message: Configure an AI provider in the Pipeline Builder before requesting a proposal.
TS0210006.solution: Configure the provider, then submit a new request.

TS0210007.message: The AI provider rejected this credential. Update the API key or its model permissions.
TS0210007.solution: Update the API key or its model permissions before retrying.

TS0210008.message: The AI provider rejected the model or request protocol.
TS0210008.solution: Check the model ID and API protocol. For current OpenAI models, select Responses API.

TS0210009.message: The AI provider rate or quota limit was reached.
TS0210009.solution: Check the provider quota and billing, or retry later.

TS0210010.message: The AI provider request failed. Check the provider settings and try again.
TS0210010.solution: Check the provider settings, then retry the request.

TS0210011.message: The AI provider reached the output token limit before completing the request.
TS0210011.solution: Review the incomplete response and reduce the requested scope before retrying.

TS0210012.message: The AI response did not contain a complete valid Pipeline proposal.
TS0210012.solution: Keep the existing Pipeline and request a complete valid proposal.

TS0210013.message: The AI assistant is busy. Try again shortly.
TS0210013.solution: Wait briefly, then submit a new request.

TS0210014.solution: Wait for an active preview to finish, then retry.

TS0210015.message: Operation '{op}' was refused because its required audit record could not be written.
TS0210015.solution: An audited operation must leave an audit record before it runs; check the store is reachable and healthy, then retry.

TS0210016.message: The artifacts were applied, but the model refresh for pipeline `{pipeline}` did not finish: {causeCode} {causeParams}. Its models may be unchanged or partially refreshed.
TS0210016.solution: Resolve the reported cause, then apply again, even if the artifact content is unchanged. Stop the pipeline and wait until it is at rest if a live run blocked the refresh. Inspect `derived-schema {pipeline}` before starting, and use `derived-schema {pipeline} --accept` only after reviewing any remaining drift.

TS0210017.message: The initial-admin bootstrap channel accepts only local (loopback) connections.
TS0210017.solution: Create the first admin from a session on the server host itself, or pre-seed one at deployment.

TS0210018.message: The initial-admin bootstrap channel is closed because an admin account already exists.
TS0210018.solution: Sign in with an existing admin account to create more users.

TS0210019.message: The `{mode}` deployment does not expose this authentication flow.
TS0210019.solution: Use the authentication entry point for the selected deployment mode.

TS0210020.message: The browser authentication public-origin configuration is invalid.
TS0210020.solution: Configure absolute HTTPS origins without paths, queries, fragments, or credentials.

TS0210021.solution: Try entering the cluster again from the Cloud Console later. If the problem persists, contact your administrator.

TS0210022.message: Cloud mode does not allow an explicit Nest state.database.
TS0210022.solution: Remove state.database to use the deployment-owned operator-state database. On-prem deployments can still select a database.

TS0210023.message: Stored Source configuration cannot be revealed by this release.
TS0210023.solution: Use the normal Source edit flow to replace configuration. A later audited reveal flow requires dedicated permission, recent step-up authentication, and a one-time grant.

TS0210024.message: Choose a different logical database name for each storage layer. Equal names cannot prove storage isolation.
TS0210024.solution: Use distinct logical database names, then test each storage layer again.

TS0210025.message: Test every storage layer again using the current settings before saving.
TS0210025.solution: Test every required layer with the current settings before saving.

TS0210026.message: The {layer} storage test failed ({causeCode}). Check the connection and permissions.
TS0210026.solution: Check the connection and permissions, then test the same layer again.

TS0210027.message: Cache database '{database}' already contains collections. Choose an empty database.
TS0210027.solution: Enter another database name and test the connection again.

TS0210028.message: Cache database '{database}' already contains collections. Choose a new, empty database.
TS0210028.solution: Try the empty name '{suggestedDatabase}' or enter another name, then test permissions again.

TS0210029.message: The storage operation or installation phase has changed. Read its current status.
TS0210029.solution: Read the current operation and installation status before deciding the next action.

TS0210030.message: The storage operation is temporarily unavailable. Query the original operation before retrying.
TS0210030.solution: Query the original operation and restore availability before considering a retry.

TS0210031.message: Initialization cannot complete because the storage endpoint has reached its space quota. Restore capacity and check the original operation; do not submit setup again.
TS0210031.solution: Restore storage capacity and inspect the original operation; do not submit setup again.

TS0210032.message: The managed AI service could not authenticate the request.
TS0210032.solution: Contact your Tapstate administrator to check the managed service credentials and permissions.

TS0210033.message: The request exceeds the input limit for the managed AI service.
TS0210033.solution: Start a new conversation or select fewer tables, then try again.

TS0210034.message: Retry settings changed after they were read.
TS0210034.solution: Reload the retry settings and reapply the desired changes.

TS0210035.message: This sign-in link is no longer valid.
TS0210035.solution: Return to the Cloud Console and select Enter for the cluster again.
